_about: Price Check data (daily/price-check-plan.md). One entry per exact model we recommend. All figures are prices seen at stores other than Amazon, or list prices, each with its source and date; never an Amazon price (Associates Program Policies 2(b), 6(y)). 'good' and 'great' are our own lines; 'verdict' is buy (buy now), ok (fair price, no reason to wait) or wait (a sale is likely soon). Change 'checked' only when the entry was really re-checked.

items.name: ThermoWorks ThermoPop 2
items.model: ThermoPop 2 (not the original ThermoPop or the Thermapen ONE).
items.why: Thanksgiving is November 26 and you want time to test it in ice water. ThermoWorks ran it at $31 (20% off) on July 1, 2026, so 20–30% off happens, but not reliably before the holiday.
items.sources: ThermoWorks via America's Test Kitchen, July 1, 2026; ThermoWorks list price, October 2026

items.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1
items.model: Duo 6-quart, model IP-DUO60 or 112-0170-01; not the Duo Plus or the 8-quart.
items.why: Past Black Friday doorbusters were about $50–$80, roughly 25–40% off list. Black Friday is November 27.
items.sources: Instant Pot store list price; Business Insider Black Friday guide (2019); Slickdeals comment (Mar 2025)

items.name: Ninja AF101 4-Quart Air Fryer
items.model: AF101, 4 quarts; check the model number, Ninja sells several similar baskets.
items.street: List $119.99; $89.99 at Best Buy, Target and Home Depot (Apr 1, 2026)
items.why: Home Depot took 32% off Ninja kitchen appliances on Black Friday 2025, which would put it near $82; a few dollars lower is our buy line.
items.sources: Slickdeals price tracker, Apr 1, 2026; NBC Select Black Friday 2025

items.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Quart Stand Mixer
items.model: Artisan KSM150, 5-quart tilt-head; colours differ in price, so compare the same colour.
items.street: List $499.99; $349 at Target and $242.29 at Lowe's (Oct 6, 2025)
items.why: It sells 25–30% below list in most big sales, and Lowe's went near half off in October 2025.

items.name: Rubbermaid Brilliance Leak-Proof Containers
items.model: Brilliance plastic sets; count the pieces, because set sizes differ by store.
items.street: Mid-teens to about $20 on sale; Target $39.99 at list (July 5, 2026)
items.why: Target took about 40% off in the Black Friday week last year; at list price it is poor value.
items.sources: Slickdeals posts, Nov 20, 2025 and July 5, 2026; BJ's, July 2026

items.name: Owala FreeSip 24 oz
items.model: FreeSip 24 oz stainless (the 32 oz lists at $35–$40).
items.why: Under $25 has been easy to find all autumn; Owala.com's 20% sitewide sale last Black Friday matched it, so there is little to wait for.
items.sources: Slickdeals trackers, Sep 6 and Oct 1, 2026; Owala.com sale, Nov 26 – Dec 1, 2025

items.name: Bissell Little Green 1400B
items.model: 1400B (corded classic); the Little Green Cordless and the Pet Pro are different machines.
items.why: Walmart listed it at $78.97 on November 3, 2025. Of our cleaning picks, this one has the clearest record of a real cut around Black Friday.

items.name: O-Cedar EasyWring Spin Mop
items.model: EasyWring 1-tank system (mop, bucket, one head); the RinseClean 2-tank is a different, pricier set.
items.why: It rarely moves much below $35; the better saving is a bundle with refill heads, which Costco has sold near $26.

items.name: Roborock Saros 10R
items.model: Saros 10R (the Saros 20 replaced it on March 23, 2026; the Saros 10 without the R is a different robot).
items.why: October already beat last year's Black Friday price of $999.99, and as a replaced model it has less room to fall.

items.name: Dreame X50 Ultra
items.model: X50 Ultra (the X60 Max Ultra Complete replaced it in February 2026).
items.why: Dreame's own store ran it at $799.99 (50% off) from November 20 to December 1, 2025; expect a clearance-style price again.

items.name: Levoit Core 300-P Air Purifier
items.model: Core 300-P; its filter is the genuine Core 300-RF.
items.why: Home Depot ran it near $49 in some stores in November 2025 (prices varied by region), so the Black Friday week is the time to check.
items.sources: Slickdeals threads, Nov 6 and Nov 26, 2025; retailer pages, Sept 2026

items.name: Bedsure Heated Throw 50 x 60
items.model: 50 x 60 in throw with the 8-hour auto-off; check the label against the March 2023 CPSC recall before first use.
items.street: Heated throws run about $20–$80; Walmart about $32 (Oct 1, 2026)
items.why: Sales take 30–45% off, but the everyday price is already low; buy when it is cold, not for the deal.

items.name: Beckham Hotel Collection Pillows (pair)
items.model: Standard/Queen set of 2 (King costs more).
items.street: About $40–$60 for the pair at major retailers
items.why: 30–40% cuts show up outside Black Friday too (Woot sold a pair at $34.99); there is no reason to wait weeks.

items.name: Dreo 1500W Ceramic Space Heater
items.model: Dreo 1500W PTC ceramic oscillating heater with thermostat and remote.
items.why: Walmart ran $29.99–$43.99 from November 2025 to January 2026. If you are cold now, under $45 is fine.
items.sources: dreo.com, Oct 15, 2026; Walmart deals, Nov 2025 – Jan 2026

items.name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40
items.model: GB40, 1000A, for gas engines up to 6.0 liters (the GB50 is the bigger one).
items.why: About $80 has been the usual deal price for two years (Woot, Aug 26, 2025); it does not usually go lower, so there is nothing to wait for before winter.

items.name: REDTIGER F7NP 4K Dash Cam
items.model: F7NP front and rear; the bundle with a 128GB card costs more than the camera alone.
items.street: Brand list $149.98 with card, $129.99 without; street about $100–$130
items.why: The crossed-out $149.98 is not the real street price; $100 or less is where it is a good buy.

items.name: ChomChom Roller
items.model: The original ChomChom Roller (look-alikes copy the shape, not the comb).
items.why: 20–30% off is common and 40% off is rare; it is already near the usual low.

items.name: KONG Classic (Large)
items.model: Classic red KONG, Large for 30–65 lb dogs (black is the Extreme).
items.why: It is cheap all year; size matters more than price.

items.name: Litter-Robot 4
items.model: Litter-Robot 4 (the EVO is a cheaper, different machine).
items.why: The price held at $699 all year; Costco's $699.99 bundle adds extras. Reconditioned units save $100 with a shorter warranty.

items.name: LUXE Bidet NEO 185
items.model: NEO 185 dual nozzle (the 185 Plus costs a few dollars more; the NEO 120 has one nozzle).
items.why: It sits near its floor all year, so a wait saves only a few dollars.

items.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
items.model: AirPods Pro 3 (2025); the AirPods 4 and Pro 2 are older models.
items.why: About $180 is already below last year's Black Friday low of $219.99.
items.sources: apple.com; TechBuzz, Nov 20, 2025; Slickdeals price table, Oct 5, 2026

items.name: Apple AirTag 2 (4-pack)
items.model: AirTag 2nd generation, 4-pack (a single is $29 list).
items.why: It launched in January 2026, so there is no Black Friday record; $80 would be about 20% off.
items.sources: MacRumors, Aug 24, 2026; The Points Guy, Oct 2026

items.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
items.model: WF-1000XM6 (2026); the XM5 is last year's model and much cheaper.
items.why: The best discount so far was about 22% off list (Oct 5, 2026); a first Black Friday usually matches or beats it.

items.name: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2
items.model: C1000 Gen 2 (the first C1000 charges more slowly).
items.why: Anker's own store sold it for $429 with a code in April 2026, so it has room to fall.

items.name: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2
items.model: Explorer 2000 v2 (2,042 Wh); the 2000 Plus is a different, heavier unit.
items.why: Wellbots sold it for $599 with a code on November 14, 2025: the clearest Black Friday-window low of our picks.

items.name: Furhaven Orthopedic Sofa Dog Bed (Large)
items.model: Large (36 x 27 x 6.5 in, size guide up to 55 lb); the Quilted style is thinner than the Plush & Suede Full Support.
items.street: Quilted $39.99 (Target, Oct 19, 2026); Plush & Suede $54.99 (PetSmart, Oct 19, 2026), list $65.99
items.why: Prices barely move between stores; a deal post showed 31% off a Plush & Suede on Nov 27, 2025. Under $45 is fine for the Large.
items.sources: Target and PetSmart pages, Oct 19, 2026; Slickdeals, Nov 27, 2025
